title: Vision, strategy, roadmap and backlog: four different documents

videos.script: Ask an engineering team to show you its plan, and you may get any of four documents. {{title}} A vision says where the company wants to be in a few years. A strategy says how it will get there, given what stands in the way. A roadmap says what happens in which order, quarter by quarter. A backlog says what the team starts next. {{four}} The trouble starts when one of them pretends to be another. The commonest case is a roadmap presented as a strategy. It has dates and projects, and it never says why. {{roadmap}} At Coreto, the roadmap before the strategy planned a whole year and never mentioned the on-sales that kept failing. After the strategy, every line on it had a reason. {{coreto}} By the end of this lesson you can tell the four apart. And you can trace any piece of work up to the reason it exists, or find out that it has none. {{trace}}
